title: For users who earned a badge in 2013 and also edited at least one post that
question: For users who earned a badge in 2013 and also edited at least one post that year, calculate the average time (in days) between their account creation and their first badge in 2013. Only include users whose edited posts have a score above 50.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(JULIANDAY(fb.first_badge) - JULIANDAY(u.XCL_054)) AS avg_days
FROM users u
JOIN (
  SELECT b.XCL_002 AS uid, MIN(b.XCL_004) AS first_badge
  FROM badges b
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2013'
  GROUP BY b.XCL_002
) fb ON u.XCL_052 = fb.uid
WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT ph.XCL_017
  FROM postHistory ph
  JOIN posts p ON ph.XCL_014 = p.XCL_026
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', ph.XCL_016) = '2013'
    AND p.XCL_031 > 50
)
